newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in UK end lower in thin session.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in UK end lower in thin session.

text.p: Hong Kong shares traded in London ended lower on Thursday weighed by drops in both the U.S. and UK markets, dealers said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index finished 56.76 points lower at 12,185.71.
"There's been nothing really going on today, it's just drifted off on the back of the U.S. jobless claims figures," said one trader.
HSBC Holdings finished down, following the UK market lower and dealers expect the Hong Kong market to drift off slightly overnight.
In Hong Kong on Thursday, the Hang Seng ended 8.1 points lower at 12,242.47 as profit-taking kept stocks just below Wednesday's record closing high.
